```lean
theorem lg_target (n : ℕ) : 6 ∣ n * (n + 1) * (n + 2) := by
  constructor
  · -- Prove 2 divides the product
    have h2 : 2 ∣ n * (n + 1) * (n + 2) := 
      dvd_mul_of_dvd_left (dvd_mul_of_dvd_right (dvd_two 2) (dvd_two 2)) (dvd_two 2)
    exact h2
  · -- Prove 3 divides the product
    have h3 : 3 ∣ n * (n + 1) * (n + 2) := 
      dvd_mul_of_dvd_left (dvd_mul_of_dvd_right (dvd_three 3) (dvd_three 3)) (dvd_three 3)
    exact h3
```
